title: Dragon Age
subtitle: all four games in release order, expansions included
blurb: 4 games and 2 expansions — about 161 hours of story, 142 of it the games themselves.
notes: Each game hands you a new protagonist, but the world remembers — companions recur and choices echo forward. Release order is the intended order; the Dragon Age Keep site rebuilds your history if you join late or switch platforms.

Only the add-ons HowLongToBeat tracks as separate entries got rows: Awakening and Trespasser, both optional, both with their own hours. Trespasser is the one with consequences — it is Inquisition's true ending and the bridge to The Veilguard. Smaller DLC rides along inside the modern editions.
HowLongToBeat main-story figures — and Inquisition in particular is famous for burying its story under optional map-clearing. The number shown is the critical path, not the Hinterlands.
Game list and years from Wikipedia's Dragon Age articles; hours from HowLongToBeat main-story figures, matched by name and year.
